name: libesedb
desc: Library and tools for Extensible Storage Engine (ESE) Database files
why: Opens Windows ESE database files, a proprietary format you can dig into and see what lives inside Active Directory and Exchange stores.

brief.what_it_is: libesedb is a C library for reading Extensible Storage Engine (ESE) database files, also called EDB files, the proprietary format used by several Windows and Microsoft server products. It takes an ESE/EDB database file as input and gives programs access to its contents. The Homebrew package also ships two command-line tools, esedbexport and esedbinfo, according to the package metadata. The README does not describe what those tools output, and I did not see their usage in the fetched pages.
brief.why_it_exists: The README says the ESE format is used in many applications, including Windows Search, Windows Mail, Exchange and Active Directory, and the project exists to provide access to files in that format. The fetched pages give no further framing from the author.
brief.install_notes: The README points to a wiki page titled Building for build-from-source instructions, which I did not fetch. Nothing in the fetched pages covers hardware, accounts, runtimes or configuration beyond that.
brief.standout: It is one of the few open-source readers for a proprietary Windows database format that also appears in Active Directory and Exchange stores. The project's own knowledge base and forensic write-up on the Windows Search database point to a forensic and investigative audience.
brief.status: The README labels the project 'Status: experimental' and lists work in progress (refactoring to handle databases over 10G) and planned multi-threading support. I could not find a release date or repository commit date in the fetched content, so recency is unknown. The wiki's last-edited date (May 14, 2026) is a wiki edit, not a code change.
brief.caveats: The README marks the project experimental. Databases larger than about 10G are a stated work in progress. Multi-threading is planned but not yet available. The licence is LGPL-3.0-or-later. The homepage text I read did not describe platform limits or missing features beyond those listed. The esedbexport and esedbinfo names come from the package metadata and were not confirmed in the README.
quotes: libesedb is a library to access the Extensible Storage Engine (ESE) Database File (EDB) format.
